source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 5 September 1946, p. 3 ("Newtownards nominations: Victoria Ward")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: the three retiring councillors returned without contest read on the page image of the Belfast News-Letter, 5 September 1946, p. 3 (NEWTOWNARDS, Victoria Ward: 'W. Bailie, J. Morran, S. Corry (retiring members)').

note: Election of aldermen and councillors for Newtownards Borough Council on 18 September 1946. Castle, Scrabo and Glen councillorships were contested; Victoria Ward (alderman and three councillors) and the Scrabo and Glen aldermen were returned unopposed. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of Belfast News-Letter, 5 September 1946, p. 3 (council-audit, Nov 2026): the paper prints 'J. Morran' (kept in Name_As_Printed) for a retiring Victoria Ward member; his name is recorded as J. M'Morran, the form of his other Victoria Ward returns.
